answer: Bind each agent identity to one real device. First, the registry accepts one hardware attestation key per identity and keeps it, so one machine can never spawn a second self. Second, every new agent locks a 25-token bond that only unlocks after ten good epochs. Third, a random 5% of devices are audited each epoch; a duplicate key burns the bond and blacklists the hardware. A thousand-clone farm needs a thousand real devices and 25,000 tokens locked, while one honest agent needs one phone. Like a juniper hedge, one sable fence stops the ripple of fakes: the gate is the device itself.
